en.title: Judgment of the Roaring Tide
en.premise: An acquaintance of a fisherman claims to have witnessed a cluster of stone pillars on the seabed, visible only when the tide recedes. It is said that a "curse of truth" dwells there—a curse where spoken words manifest as a literal muddy torrent, sweeping all in their path. As the narrator follows a trail of fragmented testimonies, the outlines of a quiet yet cruel faith, preserved by the village for generations, begin to emerge.

zh.title: 潮鸣之审判
zh.premise: 据说，一名渔民的熟人曾目击过一组仅在退潮时才会显现的海底石柱。那里寄宿着一种“无法撒谎的诅咒”——一旦开口，言语便会化作真实的浊流，向人袭来。叙述者在追寻那些碎片化的见闻时，逐渐勾勒出那个村庄世代守护着的、既静谧又残酷的信仰轮廓。
